post.text:
A few new updates just landed for Copilot! 🛬​

Check out a breakdown of what's new below. 🧵🔽

🔗 Your content, connected.​

With Connectors, Copilot searches across OneDrive, Outlook, Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Calendar using natural language. Find docs, emails, and events in seconds — with built-in privacy and full control over what’s connected. https://t.co/R6ePEDmtDH

👥 AI should bring people together. That's why we created Groups.​

​Copilot lets you collaborate in real time to keep everyone aligned with summaries, options, votes, and tasks. Start a session, send the link, and anyone can join. https://t.co/12Boxn5hgy

🌎 Copilot Mode in Edge is evolving into your AI browser — summarizing tabs, taking actions, and organizing your browsing into storylines. https://t.co/kcO9kue2Ja

📚 Learning just got more interactive.​

With Learn Live, Copilot becomes a voice-enabled Socratic tutor — guiding you through concepts, not just giving answers. https://t.co/dL3OOzCGH7

🏥 Copilot for health puts trusted answers and care within reach. It grounds responses based in credible sources like Harvard Health, and helps you find the right doctor, fast. Search by specialty, location, language, and more. https://t.co/uTgPjhD97h

✨ Meet Mico — your expressive Copilot companion.​

A warm, customizable presence that listens, reacts, and even changes color as you chat. With animations and subtle cues, Mico makes voice conversations feel more human, more connected. https://t.co/DbF24cZGzh

💻 Copilot on Windows turns every PC into an AI PC.​

From brainstorming to troubleshooting, it helps you stay focused on what matters. Say "Hey Copilot" to start a conversation, jump back into
recent files, or get real-time guidance with Vision. Simple, familiar, and ready when you are.

Check out all of Copilot's features and explore everything that’s new — smarter tools, smoother workflows, and more ways to get things done.​ ​​https://t.co/RpiePbpOWB
